svg.text: The Phantom Books shelf
One structure drawn from one book each. The instruments to reach for once the ordinary frames
have returned something bland.
/atharvan-dtd [ailment: an error, a bug class, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
remedy-first for a bug class; each remedy is a charm (the fix) and a rite (the
verification), contraindications name what forbids it, and the dosage is the smallest
remedy the rite confirms
/babel-dtd [decision with a few axes, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
enumerate a finite design space completely, mark the absurd cells, and find the catalog
that names the one that holds the answer
/catalog-dtd [directory and its index file, e.g. commands/ README.md, or leave blank for the repository root]
38 laws
verify an index against its directory in both directions; every entry is declared and
present, declared and missing, or present and orphan, and drift is a number
/clean-unclean-dtd [file, command or pipeline to audit, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
taint tracking; list every input channel of a prompt, script or pipeline as clean or
unclean, declare a rite for each unclean one, and prove the rite fires
/count-the-library-dtd [space to size or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
size a search space with a lower and an upper bound before searching it, and refuse to
enumerate what the arithmetic says cannot be enumerated
/eleusis-dtd [what to teach or onboard, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
progressive disclosure with initiation gates; lesser teachings before greater ones,
every gate has a test that can be failed, and the revelation is withheld until its gates
are passed
/formula-dtd [file or subject whose numbers to declare, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
declare the computed layer; every number a command, script or document relies on is a
formula with a term, a derivation that names the executable it was re-derived from, and
a drift count
/four-branches-dtd [change or design to narrate, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
tell the same change as four independent tales, user, operator, attacker and maintainer,
then name where the tales contradict
/goetia-dtd [task to delegate or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
read the agents actually installed, declare each with its office, seal and bound, and
summon exactly one for the task
/havamal-dtd [topic or leave blank for the current discussion]
38 laws
distill a discussion into numbered sayings that survive without context, each naming the
moment it was earned, and keep only the ones tested against a real case
/loci-dtd [subject: a directory, a topic or leave blank for the current session]
38 laws
build a memory palace for a codebase, a session or a handoff; rooms map to real places,
loci to real facts, and the walk has a fixed order
/phantom-dtd [problem or leave blank for current context]
11 laws
pick the Phantom Books command for the shape of the problem; score at least three
candidates and route to exactly one
/redaction-dtd [two sources: logs, reports, commit messages, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
two accounts of one event, quoted as readings with provenance; every difference
classified as a variant, and the archetype that explains them all
/sapiential-dtd [proposal or clever solution, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
wisdom against cleverness; every clever move names what it gains, every wise constraint
names what it protects, and each violation pairs one with the other
/sutra-dtd [calculation, estimate or decision that used shortcuts, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
audit the shortcuts in use; every heuristic is written as a rule with the exact domain
where it is valid and a counterexample that was tried
/tetralemma-dtd [proposition or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
four-cornered analysis (affirm, deny, both, neither) that ends by naming what the
proposition depends on
/voluspa-dtd [plan or situation, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
narrate the end state first, then the stanzas read backwards to it, name the one stanza
where it became irreversible, and say what stands after
/water-dtd [goal blocked by constraints, or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
find the path of least resistance through a hard constraint; mark each constraint hard,
soft or assumed, find where it yields, and route the course only through yield points
/witnesses-dtd [claim to attest, or leave blank for the current conclusion]
38 laws
separate what was seen from what was inferred; every witness says what it saw and under
what conditions, and a claim is attested only by a witness that read, ran or measured
/wu-wei-dtd [proposed action or leave blank for current context]
38 laws
the do-nothing branch as a first-class option; write what happens if nobody acts, cost
both branches in the same unit, and choose act, refrain or wait with a named condition
